paragraphs: The AMG GT C is part of the first-generation AMG GT range, produced from 2015 to 2023 under the C190 chassis code. It uses the M178 — a 4.0-litre twin-turbo V8, hand-built at Mercedes-AMG's Affalterbach facility. The M178 is a hot-vee design, with the turbos positioned between the cylinder banks, and was developed specifically for the AMG GT sports car platform. The AMG GT C sits between the GT S and GT R in the range, offering a more focused setup than the base GT while remaining more road-oriented than the hardcore GT R.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every AMG GT C on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the AMG GT C from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.
